prompt_en: A woman wearing a conical leaf hat stands at the edge of a rice field in late afternoon.
refined_prompt: A woman wearing a conical leaf hat stands at the edge of a rice field in late afternoon. In the heart of rural Vietnam, a woman stands at the edge of a lush green rice field, wearing a traditional conical leaf hat known as a "nón lá." This hat, crafted from intricately woven palm leaves, has been a symbol of resilience and hard work in Vietnamese agricultural life for centuries. As the sun begins to dip below the horizon, casting a warm golden light over the ripening rice stalks, the "nón lá" becomes a striking silhouette against the vibrant green backdrop. The hat’s textured weave and earthy tones blend seamlessly with the rustic charm of the scene, making it a quintessential image of rural Vietnamese life.
